message.reasoning:
We need to extract facts.

Text about Vienna Walzer Orchestra.

Identify entities: Vienna Walzer Orchestra (subject). Relations:

- instance of? "is a chamber orchestra" => relation: "instance of" or "type". Use maybe "instance of" or "subclass of". In example they used occupation etc. For organization, could use "type" or "instance of". We'll choose "instance of" with object "chamber orchestra". subject_type: "organization" maybe "orchestra". object_type: "musical ensemble" or "orchestra". Use "chamber orchestra" as type.

- location: "based in Vienna, Austria" => relation "location" or "headquarters location". Use "headquarters location". object "Vienna, Austria". subject_type organization, object_type location (city). Could also split into city and country but keep as "Vienna, Austria".

- specialization: "specializes in traditional Viennese waltzes, polkas, marches and operetta arias". Could create multiple relations: "musical genre" or "specializes in". Use "musical genre" with each genre. So separate triplets for each: waltzes, polkas, marches, operetta arias. object_type: "musical genre". subject_type organization.

- "from composers such as: J. Strauss II, F. Lehár, C.M. Ziehrer, among others." This indicates repertoire includes works by those composers. Could have relation "repertoire includes composer" or "composer". Use "composer" relation. Triplets: (Vienna Walzer Orchestra, composer, Johann Strauss II) etc. Need full names: J. Strauss II = Johann Strauss II. F. Lehár = Franz Lehár. C.M. Ziehrer = Carl Michael Ziehrer. Use those full names.

- "Their concerts also always include performances by ballet dancers and opera singers." This indicates concerts include performances by ballet dancers and opera singers. Could have relation "performance includes" with object "ballet dancers" and "opera singers". Or "has participant" etc. We'll create two triplets: (Vienna Walzer Orchestra, concert feature, ballet dancers) and (Vienna Walzer Orchestra, concert feature, opera singers). Use object_type "performer group". Might be "ballet dancer" (singular) but group. We'll use "ballet dancer" and "opera singer". subject_type organization.

Also need German name: "German: Wiener Walzer Orchester". Could have relation "native label" or "named in language". Use "native label" maybe. But not required. Could add (Vienna Walzer Orchestra, native label, Wiener Walzer Orchester) with qualifier language German. But spec didn't mention qualifiers for language. Might skip.

Now define types:

subject_type: "orchestra" or "organization". Use "orchestra". object_type for chamber orchestra: "musical ensemble". For location: "city". For musical genre: "musical genre". For composer: "human". For ballet dancer: "human". For opera singer: "human".

Qualifiers: none.
